Give the mark room. Leave at least one letter-stroke width of clear space. Keep proportions, X gaps, and gradient direction intact. Use the wordmark when the tagline becomes too small.

02

Electric blue. Grounded neutrals.

Keep the canvas calm. Use blue for recognition and action, cyan for emphasis. Select any swatch to copy its hex code.

Gradient directionBlue at the lower left, cyan at the upper right. Follow the ascending stroke of the X.

Readable by defaultUse white text on primary blue. Pair cyan with dark text. Reserve gray for secondary text on white.

03

A clear voice, in every weight.

Montserrat supports the custom wordmark. A geometric family with the range to make headlines confident and details easy to read.
